overview: GulfHR Shield is a high-conversion, premium HR compliance platform for Gulf SMEs. It functions as a Compliance Safety System — tracking visa expiry, payroll status, document gaps, and compliance risk with urgency-first UI, penalty exposure estimates, and ROI metrics to help businesses avoid fines and stay compliant in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
features: Dynamic compliance risk engine with 0–100 score and Low/Medium/High/Critical levels
Penalty exposure calculator in AED, SAR, OMR, QAR with monthly potential loss
Instant Demo Mode — Try Demo without signup, 20 preloaded employees, guided walkthrough
1-Click CSV/Excel employee import with auto-column detection and bulk preview
Auto HR Assistant with rule-based suggestions and action buttons
WhatsApp notification UI with per-employee toggles and notification logs
ROI Dashboard showing time saved, payroll processed, penalties avoided
Trust Layer with security badges, encryption notices, and activity history
Smart Upsell System triggered by usage limits with inline plan comparison
Conversion-focused UI with urgency colors, business language, and prominent CTAs
Step-by-step onboarding wizard with progress tracking
Optimized pricing page with FAQ, testimonials, and benefit-driven copy
Skeleton loaders and premium mobile-responsive SaaS design
